```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 2: DATA LOADING AND STANDARDIZATION PIPELINE
# ==============================================================================

# 2a. Load and Process HTS (Household Travel Survey)
# --------------------------------------------------
df_hts = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips"], low_memory=False)
df_hh = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_hh"], low_memory=False)

# Merge Household Variables (Vehicles)
df_hts = df_hts.merge(df_hh[["hh_id", "num_vehicles_4cat"]], on="hh_id", how="left")

# Standardize Columns
df_hts = df_hts.rename(columns=config_hts["col_map"])

# Filters
# Apply the SQL-style query defined in config
df_hts = df_hts.query(config_hts["filters"])

# Standardize Period & Purpose
df_hts["period"] = (
    df_hts["period"]
    .astype(str)
    .replace({"AM": "PK", "PM": "PK", "MD": "OK", "EV": "OK"})
)
df_hts["purpose"] = df_hts["purpose"].replace({"HBSch": "HBO"})
df_hts.loc[df_hts["purpose"] == "HBC", "period"] = "PK"  # Force HBC to Peak

# Standardize Modes for Hierarchy Mapping
df_hts["mode_raw"] = df_hts["mode_raw"].replace(
    {"walk-to-transit": "transit", "drive-to-transit": "transit"}
)

# Apply Hierarchy Mapping
hier_cols = list(config_hierarchy.values())
mode_map = config_hts["mode_hierarchy_map"]

# Iteratively assign hierarchy columns
for i, col_name in enumerate(hier_cols):
    df_hts[col_name] = df_hts["mode_raw"].map(lambda x: mode_map.get(x, [""] * 6)[i])

# HYBRID APPROACH: Drop 'Transit' from HTS
# We will rely on OBS for all transit data
df_hts = df_hts[df_hts[config_hierarchy["at"]] != "Transit"]

# Group HTS (now only Auto/Non-Motorized)
grp_cols = ["period", "purpose"] + hier_cols
df_hts_agg = df_hts.groupby(grp_cols, as_index=False)["weight"].sum()
df_hts_agg.rename(columns={"weight": config_output["trips_obs"]}, inplace=True)
```

```{python}
# 2b. Load and Process OBS (On-Board Survey)
# --------------------------------------------------
df_obs = pd.read_csv(config_paths["obs"], low_memory=False)

# Standardize Columns
df_obs = df_obs.rename(columns=config_obs["col_map"])

# Filters
# Apply the SQL-style query defined in config
df_obs = df_obs.query(config_obs["filters"])

# Map Values
df_obs["transit_mode"] = df_obs["transit_mode"].map(config_obs["mode_map"])
df_obs["boarding_mode"] = df_obs["boarding_mode"].map(config_obs["mode_map"])
df_obs["purpose"] = df_obs["purpose"].replace({"HBSch": "HBO"})
df_obs.loc[df_obs["purpose"] == "HBC", "period"] = "PK"

# # Scale Factors
# scale_trips = config_targets["transit_trips"] / df_obs["weight"].sum()
# scale_boards = config_targets["transit_boardings"] / df_obs["weight_board"].sum()
# df_obs["weight"] *= scale_trips
# df_obs["weight_board"] *= scale_boards

# OBS STRUCTURAL FIX: Generate Summary vs Detail Rows
# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1. Detail Rows: Specific Transit Mode, but blank High-Level columns
df_obs_detail = df_obs.groupby(
    ["period", "purpose", "transit_mode", "access_mode"], as_index=False
)["weight"].sum()
df_obs_detail.rename(
    columns={
        "transit_mode": config_hierarchy["transit"],
        "access_mode": config_hierarchy["access"],
    },
    inplace=True,
)

# Ensure hierarchy cols are blank
for col in [
    config_hierarchy["mnm"],
    config_hierarchy["at"],
    config_hierarchy["dasr"],
    config_hierarchy["occ"],
]:
    df_obs_detail[col] = ""

# 2. Summary Rows: High-Level columns, but blank Transit Mode
df_obs_summary = df_obs.groupby(["period", "purpose"], as_index=False)["weight"].sum()
df_obs_summary[config_hierarchy["mnm"]] = "Motorized"
df_obs_summary[config_hierarchy["at"]] = "Transit"

# Ensure detail cols are blank
for col in [
    config_hierarchy["dasr"],
    config_hierarchy["occ"],
    config_hierarchy["transit"],
    config_hierarchy["access"],
]:
    df_obs_summary[col] = ""

# Combine OBS parts
df_obs_agg = pd.concat([df_obs_detail, df_obs_summary], ignore_index=True)
df_obs_agg.rename(columns={"weight": config_output["trips_obs"]}, inplace=True)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 3: TDM MODEL DATA PROCESSING (one calibration run at a time)
# ==============================================================================

def _load_tdm_agg(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    tdm_dfs = []
    for period_key, period_label in [("RegionShares_Pk.csv", "PK"), ("RegionShares_Ok.csv", "OK")]:
        df_t = pd.read_csv(vs.find_one(outputs_dir, f"*{period_key}"))
        df_t["period"] = period_label
        tdm_dfs.append(df_t)

    df_tdm_raw = pd.concat(tdm_dfs)

    df_tdm_long = pd.melt(
        df_tdm_raw,
        id_vars=["period", "TripCategory"],
        value_vars=["HBCtrip", "HBOtrip", "HBWtrip", "NHBtrip"],
        var_name="purpose",
        value_name="trips",
    )
    df_tdm_long["purpose"] = df_tdm_long["purpose"].str.replace("trip", "")
    df_tdm_long["TripCategory"] = df_tdm_long["TripCategory"].str.strip()
    df_tdm_long["trips"] = pd.to_numeric(df_tdm_long["trips"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    df_tdm_long = df_tdm_long[
        df_tdm_long["TripCategory"].isin(config_tdm_map.keys())
    ].copy()

    for i, col_name in enumerate(hier_cols):
        df_tdm_long[col_name] = df_tdm_long["TripCategory"].map(
            lambda x: config_tdm_map.get(x, [""] * 6)[i]
        )

    df_agg = df_tdm_long.groupby(["period", "purpose"] + hier_cols, as_index=False)["trips"].sum()
    return df_agg.rename(columns={"trips": config_output["trips_model"]})

df_tdm_agg = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_tdm_agg)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 4: MERGE AND CALCULATE
# ==============================================================================

# calib_run isn't a merge key -- rides along on df_tdm_agg's side, repeating
# df_observed_final (not run-specific) across each run, same pattern as elsewhere
merge_cols = ["period", "purpose"] + hier_cols
df_comp = pd.merge(df_tdm_agg, df_observed_final, on=merge_cols, how="outer").fillna(0)

# Prepare Data for Dashboard (Charts)
chart_data_frames = []

for grp_key, grp_col_name in config_hierarchy.items():
    # 0. CRITICAL FIX: Filter for valid hierarchy categories ONLY
    # This prevents double counting. For example, when calculating 'Motorized' shares,
    # we must exclude the 'Detail' rows from OBS which have ModeGroup=""
    df_subset = df_comp[df_comp[grp_col_name] != ""].copy()

    # 1. Base Aggregation (calib_run kept in every groupby below so runs
    #    don't get summed together -- df_comp carries multiple runs' worth
    #    of modeled data, see PHASE 3/4 above)
    grp_cols = [grp_col_name, "period", "purpose", "calib_run"]
    df_view = df_subset.groupby(grp_cols, as_index=False)[
        [config_output["trips_model"], config_output["trips_obs"]]
    ].sum()

    # 2. Add 'Daily' totals
    df_dy = df_view.groupby([grp_col_name, "purpose", "calib_run"], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True)
    df_dy["period"] = "DY"
    df_view = pd.concat([df_view, df_dy])

    # 3. Add 'All Purposes' totals
    df_all = df_view.groupby([grp_col_name, "period", "calib_run"], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True)
    df_all["purpose"] = "All"
    df_view = pd.concat([df_view, df_all])

    # 4. Calculate Percentages
    # Now that blank rows are removed, this sum represents the True All for this hierarchy level
    df_totals = df_view.groupby(["period", "purpose", "calib_run"], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True)
    df_totals = df_totals.rename(
        columns={
            config_output["trips_model"]: "AllModel",
            config_output["trips_obs"]: "AllObs",
        }
    )

    df_view = df_view.merge(df_totals, on=["period", "purpose", "calib_run"], how="left")

    df_view[config_output["share_model"]] = df_view[
        config_output["trips_model"]
    ] / df_view["AllModel"].replace(0, np.nan)
    df_view[config_output["share_obs"]] = df_view[config_output["trips_obs"]] / df_view[
        "AllObs"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Formatting
    df_view[config_output["mode_group"]] = grp_col_name
    df_view.rename(columns={grp_col_name: config_output["mode_detail"]}, inplace=True)

    # We don't need to filter != "" here anymore because we did it at step 0,
    # but keeping it doesn't hurt.
    chart_data_frames.append(df_view)

# Combine and Finalize
df_long = pd.concat(chart_data_frames, ignore_index=True)

# OJS HANDSHAKE:
df_long = df_long.rename(
    columns={
        "period": "Period",
        "purpose": "TripPurpose",
        config_output["mode_detail"]: "Mode",
    }
)


# Select columns using the config names
final_cols = [
    "Period",
    "TripPurpose",
    config_output["mode_group"],  # Preserves 'ModeGroup'
    "Mode",
    config_output["share_model"],
    config_output["share_obs"],
]
df_final = df_long.copy()

df_final.rename(
    columns={
        config_output["share_model"]: "Model",
        config_output["share_obs"]: "Observed",
    },
    inplace=True,
)
df_final["Difference"] = df_final["Model"] - df_final["Observed"]

# Melt for OJS
df_final_melt = pd.melt(
    df_final,
    id_vars=[
        "Period",
        "TripPurpose",
        config_output["mode_group"],
        "Mode",
    ],
    value_vars=["Model", "Observed"],
    var_name="DataSource",
    value_name="Percent",
)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 5: BOARDINGS VALIDATION
# ==============================================================================

# Explicitly define the columns to sum
skim_cols = [
    "Board_FromSkim_LCL",
    "Board_FromSkim_COR",
    "Board_FromSkim_EXP",
    "Board_FromSkim_BRT",
    "Board_FromSkim_LRT",
    "Board_FromSkim_CRT",
]

# CRITICAL FIX: RECLASSIFY MICROTRANSIT FOR VALIDATION
# We treat Surveyed Microtransit (Mode 1) as "Local Bus" for these charts only.
# This ensures they are counted in the "Local Bus" row during the loop below.
# (One-time, not run-specific -- df_obs itself isn't run-specific.)
df_obs["boarding_mode"] = df_obs["boarding_mode"].replace("Microtransit", "Local Bus")

# Mode Label | Skim Code (Col) | Mode ID (Row)
validation_config = [
    ("Local Bus", "LCL", 4),
    ("Core Bus", "COR", 5),
    ("Express Bus", "EXP", 6),
    ("BRT", "BRT", 9),
    ("LRT", "LRT", 7),
    ("CRT", "CRT", 8),
]


def _load_boardings(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    df_tdm_brd_raw = pd.read_csv(vs.find_one(outputs_dir, "*transit_brding_summary_node.csv"))
    df_tdm_agg_run = df_tdm_agg[df_tdm_agg["calib_run"] == calib_run]

    def get_tdm_hier_boardings(skim_code):
        target_col = f"Board_FromSkim_{skim_code}"
        if target_col in df_tdm_brd_raw.columns:
            return df_tdm_brd_raw[target_col].sum()
        return 0

    def get_tdm_surv_boardings(mode_id):
        subset = df_tdm_brd_raw[df_tdm_brd_raw["Mode"] == mode_id]
        return subset[skim_cols].sum().sum()

    validation_rows = []
    for mode_label, skim_code, mode_id in validation_config:
        trips_mod = df_tdm_agg_run[df_tdm_agg_run[config_hierarchy["transit"]] == mode_label][
            config_output["trips_model"]
        ].sum()
        trips_obs = df_obs_agg[df_obs_agg[config_hierarchy["transit"]] == mode_label][
            config_output["trips_obs"]
        ].sum()
        brd_mod_hier = get_tdm_hier_boardings(skim_code)
        brd_obs_hier = df_obs[df_obs["transit_mode"] == mode_label]["weight_board"].sum()
        brd_mod_surv = get_tdm_surv_boardings(mode_id)
        brd_obs_surv = df_obs[df_obs["boarding_mode"] == mode_label]["weight_board"].sum()
        validation_rows.append(
            {
                "Mode": mode_label,
                "Trips_Mod": trips_mod,
                "Trips_Obs": trips_obs,
                "Board_Mod": brd_mod_hier,
                "Board_Obs": brd_obs_hier,
                "Board_Surv_Mod": brd_mod_surv,
                "Board_Surv_Obs": brd_obs_surv,
            }
        )

    df_val = pd.DataFrame(validation_rows)

    system_trips_obs = df_obs["weight"].sum()
    system_board_obs = df_obs["weight_board"].sum()
    system_board_mod = df_val["Board_Mod"].sum()
    total_row = {
        "Mode": "All",
        "Trips_Mod": df_val["Trips_Mod"].sum(),
        "Trips_Obs": system_trips_obs,
        "Board_Mod": system_board_mod,
        "Board_Obs": system_board_obs,
        "Board_Surv_Mod": system_board_mod,
        "Board_Surv_Obs": system_board_obs,
    }
    df_val = pd.concat([df_val, pd.DataFrame([total_row])], ignore_index=True)

    def make_view_df(title, col_mod, col_obs):
        df = df_val[["Mode", col_mod, col_obs]].copy()
        df.columns = ["Mode", "Model", "Observed"]
        df["Title"] = title
        df["Difference"] = df["Model"] - df["Observed"]
        df["% Difference"] = (df["Difference"] / df["Observed"]).fillna(0)
        return df

    df_v1 = make_view_df("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Trips_Mod", "Trips_Obs")
    df_v2 = make_view_df("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Board_Mod", "Board_Obs")
    df_v3 = make_view_df("Boardings by Mode Surveyed", "Board_Surv_Mod", "Board_Surv_Obs")

    df_v4 = df_val[["Mode"]].copy()
    df_v4["Model"] = df_val["Board_Mod"] / df_val["Trips_Mod"].replace(0, np.nan)
    df_v4["Observed"] = df_val["Board_Obs"] / df_val["Trips_Obs"].replace(0, np.nan)
    df_v4["Title"] = "Transfer Ratio"
    df_v4["Difference"] = df_v4["Model"] - df_v4["Observed"]
    df_v4["% Difference"] = (df_v4["Difference"] / df_v4["Observed"]).fillna(0)

    return pd.concat([df_v1, df_v2, df_v3, df_v4], ignore_index=True)


df_boardings_long = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_boardings)

# OJS HANDSHAKE
df_step1 = pd.melt(
    df_boardings_long,
    id_vars=["Mode", "Title", "Difference", "% Difference", "calib_run"],
    value_vars=["Model", "Observed"],
    var_name="DataSource",
    value_name="Value",
)

df_boardings_viz = pd.melt(
    df_step1,
    id_vars=["Mode", "Title", "DataSource", "calib_run"],
    value_vars=["Value", "Difference", "% Difference"],
    var_name="View",
    value_name="ViewValue",
)

# Remove totals for charts
df_boardings_viz = df_boardings_viz[df_boardings_viz["Mode"] != "All"]
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 6: DYNAMIC TEXT VARIABLES
# ==============================================================================

# Helper to grab a specific % Difference from our results
def get_stat(title, mode):
    try:
        val = df_boardings_long[
            (df_boardings_long["Title"] == title) & (df_boardings_long["Mode"] == mode)
        ]["% Difference"].values[0]
        return f"{val:.1%}"  # Formats as percentage with 1 decimal (e.g., "-1.3%")
    except IndexError:
        return "ERR"


# Dictionary holding all the dynamic text values
txt = {
    # All System Stats
    "trips_tot": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "All"),
    "board_tot": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "All"),
    # BRT Stats
    "brt_trips": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "BRT"),
    "brt_board": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "BRT"),
    # Core Bus Stats
    "cor_trips": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Core Bus"),
    "cor_board": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Core Bus"),
    "cor_surv": get_stat(
        "Boardings by Mode Surveyed", "Core Bus"
    ),  # The overprediction stat
    # Express Bus Stats
    "exp_trips": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Express Bus"),
    "exp_board": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Express Bus"),
    "exp_surv": get_stat(
        "Boardings by Mode Surveyed", "Express Bus"
    ),  # The underprediction stat
}
```

## Transit Trips and Boardings

Transit trips were validated to the 2024 Transit On-Board Survey and 2023 observed boarding data. To facilitate model calibration, transit trips, boardings, and transfers were validated by the model’s hierarchical mode. Boardings were also validated based on the mode where the boarding was actually observed. Transit validation results are shown in @fig-mc-boardings.

Total transit trips and boardings were calibrated to within 5% of observed data (trips `{python} txt['trips_tot']`, boardings `{python} txt['board_tot']`). Overall transfers were all within an acceptable range.

Transit trips and boardings by mode were calibrated to acceptable ranges for modes with significant ridership. Modes with low ridership were allowed to have a higher difference when compared to observed data if calibrating to increase base year accuracy resulted in too large alternative specific constants (i.e. over calibrating these modes). However, the following suggestions may help guide when using the model and interpreting model results:

 - BRT validation results were low (between `{python} txt['brt_trips']` and `{python} txt['brt_board']`). However, only one BRT route (UVX) was available in 2019 to calibrate this mode. Partly due to this, additional rounds of calibration to improve BRT resulted in large constants. This in turn would have the effect of making the base year validation better but overpredicting BRT in future forecasts, particularly as there is significantly more BRT in future plan phases. The decision was made to allow BRT to show lower than expected ridership in the earlier years of the model in favor of more reasonable BRT future-year forecasts.
 - Core Route validation statistics are not applicable because the only Core Route operational in the base year (3500 S) was reclassified as a Local Bus. This adjustment removed all observed ridership from this category, resulting in undefined validation metrics. Consequently, the model is predicting trips for a mode structure preserved for future phases, while the observed dataset for this specific category is empty.
 - Express Bus trip and boarding validation results are higher than desired (`{python} txt['exp_trips']` and `{python} txt['exp_board']`, respectively). However, Express Bus ridership in 2019 is not significant and Express Bus service is expected to decrease in future plan phases. Note that the model underpredicts overall boardings (`{python} txt['exp_surv']`) largely due to the observed data showing trips in the downtown area are transferring from other modes (e.g. CRT) to use Express Bus more as a local downtown circulator. The model does not capture this behavior.

#### Commuter Rail Station Boardings
The comparison of base year (2019) station-level boardings for commuter-rail transit (CRT) is found in @fig-fr-brd. CRT boardings were found to be higher than observed for Davis County and lower than observed for Utah County. An adjustment of 5 additional minutes to in-vehicle-time for trips to/from Davis County and 5 fewer minute to in-vehicle-time for Utah County was made to attempt to bring the model more in-line with observations.

Additional investigation was conducted into why Provo and Lehi were particularly low in the model. The findings did not turn up any obvious errors in the transit or model network. So, the conclusion is that further adjustments to CRT will be possible in the Mode Choice Update project that is currently being undertaken for the next release of the model.

```{python}
# (one calibration run at a time)
def _load_mod_boarding(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    df = (
        pd.read_csv(vs.find_one(outputs_dir, "*transit_brding_summary_node.csv"))
        .query("Mode == 8")
        .groupby(["N", "AccessMode"])[["Board", "Alight"]]
        .sum()
        .mean(axis=1)
        .reset_index(name="Boardings")
    )
    # 2. Merge with station names
    df = df.merge(
        df_station_master[["Stop_Name", "Model_N"]],
        left_on="N",
        right_on="Model_N",
        how="left",
    )
    # 3. Clean up columns
    df["Access_Type"] = df["AccessMode"].str.title()
    df["Source"] = "Modeled"
    return df

df_mod_boarding = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_mod_boarding)
```

```{python}
df_obs_raw = pd.read_csv(config_paths["obs_board"]).query(
    "Mode_Fin == 8 and DATE_TYPE == 'Weekday'"
)

# 1. Dynamic regex and mapping from master list
stop_pattern = (
    "^(" + "|".join(map(re.escape, df_station_master["UTA_Stops"].tolist())) + ")"
)
name_map = dict(zip(df_station_master["UTA_Stops"], df_station_master["Stop_Name"]))

# 1. Vectorized Directional Logic (Board/Alight and Access Mode)
pa_mask = df_obs_raw["PA_AP"] == "PA"
df_obs_raw["B_Stop"] = np.where(
    pa_mask, df_obs_raw["STOP_ON_ADDR"], df_obs_raw["STOP_OFF_ADDR"]
).astype(str)
df_obs_raw["A_Stop"] = np.where(
    pa_mask, df_obs_raw["STOP_OFF_ADDR"], df_obs_raw["STOP_ON_ADDR"]
).astype(str)
df_obs_raw["Access_Type"] = np.where(
    pa_mask, df_obs_raw["Ac_Mode2_Model"], df_obs_raw["Eg_Mode2_Model"]
)

# 2. Standardize Names
df_obs_raw["S_B"] = (
    df_obs_raw["B_Stop"].str.extract(stop_pattern, expand=False).map(name_map)
)
df_obs_raw["S_A"] = (
    df_obs_raw["A_Stop"].str.extract(stop_pattern, expand=False).map(name_map)
)

# 3. Combine Events and Average (Sum / 2)
df_obs_boarding = pd.concat(
    [
        df_obs_raw[["S_B", "Access_Type", "boarding_weight"]].rename(
            columns={"S_B": "Stop_Name"}
        ),
        df_obs_raw[["S_A", "Access_Type", "boarding_weight"]].rename(
            columns={"S_A": "Stop_Name"}
        ),
    ]
).dropna(subset=["Stop_Name"])

df_obs_boarding = (
    df_obs_boarding.groupby(["Stop_Name", "Access_Type"], as_index=False)[
        "boarding_weight"
    ]
    .sum()
    .assign(Boardings=lambda x: x["boarding_weight"] / 2, Source="On-Board Survey")[
        ["Stop_Name", "Access_Type", "Boardings", "Source"]
    ]
)
```

```{python}
# | eval: false

# Reference: https://maps.rideuta.com/portal/apps/sites/#/uta-open-data/datasets/6eb88701ef9741f7a19f0b5b84f66770/api

# 1. Flexible parameters dictionary
query_params = {
    "mode": "Commuter Rail",
    "route": "FrontRunner",
    "year_": 2023,
    "servicetype": "WKD",
    "month_": ["September", "October", "November"],
}

# 2. Build the WHERE clause dynamically
clauses = []
for key, value in query_params.items():
    if isinstance(value, list):
        # Handle lists with IN ('A', 'B')
        list_str = ", ".join([f"'{v}'" for v in value])
        clauses.append(f"{key} IN ({list_str})")
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        # Handle strings with single quotes
        clauses.append(f"{key} = '{value}'")
    else:
        # Handle numbers/booleans
        clauses.append(f"{key} = {value}")

where_clause = " AND ".join(clauses)

# 3. Setup API and Fetch
url = "https://maps.rideuta.com/server/rest/services/Hosted/RAIL_STOP_RIDERSHIP_TABLE_SINCE_2017/FeatureServer/0/query"
api_params = {"where": where_clause, "outFields": "*", "f": "json"}

df_apc_boarding = (
    pd.json_normalize(requests.get(url, params=api_params).json()["features"])
    .rename(columns=lambda x: x.replace("attributes.", "").lower())
    .groupby("stopname")[["avgboardings", "avgalightings"]]
    .mean()
    .assign(Boardings=lambda x: x.mean(axis=1))  # Average of board and alight
    .reset_index()
)

# 2. Merge with station names
df_apc_boarding = df_apc_boarding.merge(
    df_station_master[["Stop_Name", "UTA_Stops"]],
    left_on="stopname",
    right_on="UTA_Stops",
    how="left",
)

# 3. Clean up columns
df_apc_boarding["Access_Type"] = "All"
df_apc_boarding["Source"] = "Passenger Counts"
```

```{python}
df_apc_boarding["Source"] = "Passenger Counts"
```

```{ojs}
// 1. Prepare data for the table: Pivot from Long to Wide format
pivoted_table_data = {
  const current_sources = Array.from(new Set(filtered_data_boarding.map(d => d.Source))).sort();

  const rollup = new Map();
  for (const d of filtered_data_boarding) {
    if (!rollup.has(d.Stop_Name)) rollup.set(d.Stop_Name, new Map());
    const stopMap = rollup.get(d.Stop_Name);
    const currentVal = stopMap.get(d.Source) || 0;
    stopMap.set(d.Source, currentVal + d.Boardings);
  }

  const tableRows = sort_order.map(stop => {
    const row = { "Station Name": stop };
    for (const src of current_sources) {
      const stopMap = rollup.get(stop);
      row[src] = stopMap ? (stopMap.get(src) || 0) : 0;
    }
    return row;
  });

  // Create All Row (Keep as plain strings/numbers for now)
  const totalRow = { "Station Name": "All" };
  for (const src of current_sources) {
    totalRow[src] = d3.sum(tableRows, d => d[src]);
  }

  return [...tableRows, totalRow];
}

// 2. Render the Table
Inputs.table(pivoted_table_data, {
  columns: [
    "Station Name",
    ...Object.keys(pivoted_table_data[0] || {}).filter(k => k !== "Station Name")
  ],
  format: {
    // Bold the "Station Name" if it is the All row
    "Station Name": d => d === "All" ? html`<b>${d}</b>` : d,

    // Apply formatting and bolding to all dynamic source columns
    ...Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(pivoted_table_data[0] || {}).filter(k => k !== "Station Name").map(k => [
        k, (val, i, data) => {
          const isAll = data[i]["Station Name"] === "All";
          const formatted = val.toLocaleString("en-US", {maximumFractionDigits: 0});
          return isAll ? html`<b>${formatted}</b>` : formatted;
        }
      ])
    )
  },
  layout: "auto",
  rows: 21
})
```

#### Commuter Rail Distance Travelled

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 7: CRT TRIP DISTANCE FREQUENCY
# ==============================================================================

# NOTE: alltrips_pk/ok and skm_w8/d8_pk/ok aren't yet declared in
# calibration_runs/*.yaml's outputs.include (CONVERTMAT tab names
# unconfirmed) -- this whole section will raise until that's added.
#
# Distance is looked up from the MODELED skim even for "Observed" trips (an
# observed trip's O-D pair positioned onto the model's distance skim), so
# both Modeled and Observed chunks are run-dependent here -- the whole
# computation runs once per calibration run.

def _load_skm(outputs_dir, filename):
    with omx.open_file(outputs_dir / filename) as f:
        return np.array(f["D8"])


def _load_trips(outputs_dir, filename, matrix):
    # values are trips x 100, so divide
    with omx.open_file(outputs_dir / filename) as f:
        return np.array(f[matrix]) / 100.0


def _load_crt_dist(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    # --- 7a/7b. Load Distance Skims + Trip Matrices ---
    skm_w8_pk = _load_skm(outputs_dir, "skm_w8_Pk.omx")
    skm_w8_ok = _load_skm(outputs_dir, "skm_w8_Ok.omx")
    skm_d8_pk = _load_skm(outputs_dir, "skm_d8_Pk.omx")
    skm_d8_ok = _load_skm(outputs_dir, "skm_d8_Ok.omx")

    trp_w8_pk = _load_trips(outputs_dir, "AllTrips_Pk.omx", "wCRT")
    trp_w8_ok = _load_trips(outputs_dir, "AllTrips_Ok.omx", "wCRT")
    trp_d8_pk = _load_trips(outputs_dir, "AllTrips_Pk.omx", "dCRT")
    trp_d8_ok = _load_trips(outputs_dir, "AllTrips_Ok.omx", "dCRT")

    # --- 7c. Build Modeled Records ---
    _model_chunks = []
    for trips, skm, period, access in [
        (trp_w8_pk, skm_w8_pk, "PK", "Walk"),
        (trp_w8_ok, skm_w8_ok, "OK", "Walk"),
        (trp_d8_pk, skm_d8_pk, "PK", "Drive"),
        (trp_d8_ok, skm_d8_ok, "OK", "Drive"),
    ]:
        mask = trips > 0
        _model_chunks.append(
            pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "Distance": skm[mask],
                    "Trips": trips[mask],
                    "Period": period,
                    "AccessMode": access,
                    "Source": "Modeled",
                }
            )
        )
    df_crt_model = pd.concat(_model_chunks, ignore_index=True)

    # --- 7d. Build Observed Records ---
    df_crt_obs_raw = df_obs[df_obs["transit_mode"] == "CRT"].copy()

    _skim_map = {
        ("PK", "Walk"): skm_w8_pk,
        ("PK", "Drive"): skm_d8_pk,
        ("OK", "Walk"): skm_w8_ok,
        ("OK", "Drive"): skm_d8_ok,
    }

    _obs_chunks = []
    for (period, access), grp in df_crt_obs_raw.groupby(["period", "access_mode"]):
        skm = _skim_map.get((period, access))
        if skm is None:
            continue
        grp = grp.dropna(subset=["p_TAZID", "a_TAZID"])
        if grp.empty:
            continue
        r = grp["p_TAZID"].astype(int).values - 1
        c = grp["a_TAZID"].astype(int).values - 1
        valid = (r >= 0) & (r < skm.shape[0]) & (c >= 0) & (c < skm.shape[1])
        _obs_chunks.append(
            pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "Distance": skm[r[valid], c[valid]],
                    "Trips": grp["weight"].values[valid],
                    "Period": period,
                    "AccessMode": access,
                    "Source": "Observed",
                }
            )
        )

    df_crt_obs = pd.concat(_obs_chunks, ignore_index=True) if _obs_chunks else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["Distance", "Trips", "Period", "AccessMode", "Source"]
    )

    # --- 7e. Combine ---
    return (
        pd.concat([df_crt_model, df_crt_obs], ignore_index=True)
        .query("Distance > 0 and Distance < 200")  # guard against skim fill-values
        .round({"Distance": 2, "Trips": 4})
    )


df_crt_dist = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_crt_dist)
ojs_define(crtDistFreq_py=df_crt_dist)
```

```{ojs}
// ── 1. Filter by Period, Access Mode, and Calibration Run ────────────────────
_periodCode = crtPeriodSel === "Peak" ? "PK" : crtPeriodSel === "Off-Peak" ? "OK" : null
_accessCode = crtAccessSel === "All" ? null : crtAccessSel

crtFiltered = crtData.filter(d =>
  d.calib_run === crtDistCalibRunSelect &&
  (_periodCode === null || d.Period     === _periodCode) &&
  (_accessCode === null || d.AccessMode === _accessCode)
)

// ── 2. Build histogram bins for each Source ──────────────────────────────────
crtBinned = {
  const rawMax = d3.max(crtFiltered, d => d.Distance);
  const maxDist = rawMax ? Math.ceil(rawMax / crtBinSize) * crtBinSize : 120;
  const thresholds = d3.range(0, maxDist + crtBinSize, crtBinSize);

  const rows = [];
  for (const source of ["Observed", "Modeled"]) {
    const src = crtFiltered.filter(d => d.Source === source);
    const totalTrips = d3.sum(src, d => d.Trips);

    for (let i = 0; i < thresholds.length - 1; i++) {
      const lo = thresholds[i];
      const hi = thresholds[i + 1];
      const trips = d3.sum(
        src.filter(d => d.Distance >= lo && d.Distance < hi),
        d => d.Trips
      );
      rows.push({
        BinLo  : lo,
        BinHi  : hi,
        BinMid : (lo + hi) / 2,
        Trips  : trips,
        Share  : totalTrips > 0 ? trips / totalTrips : 0,
        Source : source,
      });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}
```
